raw.description: 虚无：自身受到攻击伤害后，免疫下1次受到的技能伤害|元素：登场时，消除对手回合类效果，消除成功则令对手下1次技能无效|能量：战斗阶段结束时，附加自身已损失体力50%的百分比伤害（boss有效）|生命：战斗阶段结束时，恢复自身最大体力的1/4和随机2个PP值不为满的技能1点PP值（boss有效）|轮回：自身首次于对手出手回合受到致死伤害时当回合保留，同时回合结束后自身体力、PP值、能力等级返回当回合选择操作之后的状态|永恒：回合开始时，若自身体力高于对手则当回合自身技能必定先手|圣洁：免疫受到的异常状态和能力下降状态（boss有效）|（标注部分boss有效，其余无效）

review.rationale: API正文与格式化字段的范围冲突保留，按用户否回答只免技能红伤，真实固粉真和梅赫独立属性直伤均不免不消费，末生命/能量/轮回完整伤害交互保留。
review.singleBehavior: 元素初始清回合成功封下一技能；虚无受到正技能攻击红伤后预备免下一次技能红伤，同次技能生成预备不反免自己，零结算不新授；属性直伤/固定/百分比/真实不免且不消费。能量按已损HP一半末附粉、生命末四分一HP与随机两未满PP无放回各1；轮回首次敌方行动致命整回保留并末返回选择操作之后HP/PP/等级；永恒HP高于敌必先手；免异免弱。
review.deferredBehavior: 后续真正再次登场时重新触发元素清对手回合及成功后的下次技能无效。
review.trigger: 持有者真正换宠后再登场，当前对手存在回合效果并被成功清除
futureMechanisms: 真实下场与再次登场事件
登场时刻当前对手与回合效果保护

dependencyEvidence.quote: 登场时，消除对手回合类效果

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review

success.name: 5000/753轮回真实发生过强化、消耗和PP回复后回末还原选择快照，免弱不阻返回原等级
success.assertion: test('5000/753轮回真实发生过强化、消耗和PP回复后回末还原选择快照，免弱不阻返回原等级',()=>{const s=make({move:25679,soul:true,hp:100,aStats:{spe:1},bStats:{atk:9999,spe:500}});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;const before={hp:100,pp:{...s.fighters[0].pp},stages:{...s.fighters[0].stages}},old=E.SOULS;let actualStages;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0)actualStages={...c.a.stages};}};try{turn(s,25679,10127);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.ok(actualStages.atk>0);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.lifePP[0].chosen.some(x=>x.before!==x.after));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,before.hp);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].pp,before.pp);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].stages,before.stages);});

success.name: 5000/753轮回已1HP受正结算攻击与附固均保1而实际HP损失0，正伤害仍获虚无；自身出手受到真实816反伤不触发轮回
success.assertion: test('5000/753轮回已1HP受正结算攻击与附固均保1而实际HP损失0，正伤害仍获虚无；自身出手受到真实816反伤不触发轮回',()=>{const s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{spe:1},bStats:{spe:500},enemySource:source,enemySoul:true,enemyLoadout:[10994,10993,10996,20607,31143]});s.fighters[1].soulId=null;turn(s,20606,10994);const incoming=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.targetSide===0);assert.ok(incoming.some(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.settledDamage>0&&e.hpLoss===0));assert.ok(incoming.some(e=>e.type==='fixed'&&e.settledDamage===30&&e.hpLoss===0));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge);const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4995/snapshot.json'),x=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,loadout:[20606,10993,10996,20607,31143],enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[29463,20276,20565,11141,38550]});x.moveDefinitions[key(29463)].operations=x.moveDefinitions[key(29463)].operations.filter(o=>o.effectId===816);turn(x,20606,29463);x.fighters[0].hp=1;turn(x,10993,20276);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.reincarnationUsed,false);});

success.name: 5000/753属性直伤不当作攻击触发虚无，生命魂印回复不受技能禁疗限制且粉伤免疫不妨碍生命回复
success.assertion: test('5000/753属性直伤不当作攻击触发虚无，生命魂印回复不受技能禁疗限制且粉伤免疫不妨碍生命回复',()=>{const enemy=require('../data/species/4355.json').snapshot,s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[27925,10250,20065,10628,35797]});s.moveDefinitions[key(27925)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(27925)].operations.filter(o=>o.effectId===1792);turn(s,20606,27925);assert.ok(s.damageEvents.some(e=>e.redCategory==='attribute'&&e.hpLoss>0));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge,undefined);const x=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(x,0,'技能禁疗',{});timer(x,1,'固定百分比免疫',{});turn(x,20606,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].hp,3250);assert.equal(x.fighters[1].hp,9000);assert.equal((x.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='percent').reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),0);});

success.name: 5000/753元素真实入场清回合成功才封下次整招，失败不授，圣洁免异常与弱化
success.assertion: test('5000/753元素真实入场清回合成功才封下次整招，失败不授，圣洁免异常与弱化',()=>{for(const active of[false,true]){const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===0&&active)c.t.effects['免弱']={start:1,end:3};old.run(e,c);}};let s;try{s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.nextSkillInvalid??0,active?1:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['免弱'],undefined);turn(s,20606,10127);if(active)assert.equal(red(s),0);}const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4995/snapshot.json');for(const move of[20565,38549]){const s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[20565,38549,20276,11141,38550]});s.moveDefinitions[key(38549)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(38549)].operations.filter(x=>x.effectId===1447);turn(s,20606,move);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,0);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});}});

success.name: 5000/753能量先按损失HP一半附粉，生命再回复四分之一且随机两个未满PP无放回，只有一个候选不补抽
success.assertion: test('5000/753能量先按损失HP一半附粉，生命再回复四分之一且随机两个未满PP无放回，只有一个候选不补抽',()=>{const s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});s.fighters[0].pp[key(25679)]=0;turn(s,20606,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),4000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,3250);const picked=s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.lifePP[0].chosen;assert.equal(picked.length,2);assert.equal(new Set(picked.map(x=>x.key)).size,2);assert.ok(picked.every(x=>x.after-x.before===1));const one=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true});turn(one,20606,20309);assert.equal(one.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.lifePP[0].chosen.length,1);assert.equal(one.fighters[0].pp[key(20606)],source.moves.find(m=>m.id===20606).pp);});

success.name: 5000/753永恒严格HP高于对手必先手，等于与低于时仍按真实先制速度，技能先制不改写
success.assertion: test('5000/753永恒严格HP高于对手必先手，等于与低于时仍按真实先制速度，技能先制不改写',()=>{for(const hp of[8999,9000,9001]){const s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{maxHp:9999,spe:1},bStats:{spe:500}});turn(s,20606,10127);assert.equal(s.turns[0].first,hp>9000?0:1);assert.equal(s.moveDefinitions[key(20606)].priority,0);}});

success.name: 5000/753正技能红伤后免下次技能红伤，零伤不再授予，第三招恢复；同招200固伤不免
success.assertion: test('5000/753正技能红伤后免下次技能红伤，零伤不再授予，第三招恢复；同招200固伤不免',()=>{const s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});turn(s,20606,10127);assert.ok(red(s)>0);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge);turn(s,20606,10127);assert.equal(red(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge,undefined);turn(s,20606,10127);assert.ok(red(s)>0);const x=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,enemySource:source,enemySoul:true,enemyLoadout:[11261,10993,10996,20607,31143]});x.fighters[1].soulId=null;turn(x,20606,10993);const before=x.fighters[0].hp;turn(x,20606,11261);assert.equal(x.round,3);assert.equal(red(x),0);assert.equal(sum(x,'fixed',1),200);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge,undefined);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].hp,Math.min(9000,before-200+2250));});

success.name: 5000/753轮回首次敌方行动致命整回保1，完整伤害与HP损失独立，回末精确返回选择后HP/PP/等级，次轮虚无阻挡，耗尽后轮回不再触发
success.assertion: test('5000/753轮回首次敌方行动致命整回保1，完整伤害与HP损失独立，回末精确返回选择后HP/PP/等级，次轮虚无阻挡，耗尽后轮回不再触发',()=>{const s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp:100,aStats:{spe:1},bStats:{atk:9999,spe:500}}),before={hp:s.fighters[0].hp,pp:{...s.fighters[0].pp},stages:{...s.fighters[0].stages}};turn(s,20606,10127);const e=events(s).find(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1);assert.ok(e.settledDamage>100);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,99);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,before.hp);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].pp,before.pp);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].stages,before.stages);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.reincarnationUsed,true);assert.equal(s.turns[0].remainingHp[0],100);turn(s,20606,10127);assert.equal(red(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.savedRound,1);s.fighters[0].hp=100;turn(s,20606,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.finished,true);});

success.name: 5000已答虚无不免固粉真也不消费预备次数，随后下一技能红伤才消费，真实10716红伤归零附加50固伤仍扣HP
success.assertion: test('5000已答虚无不免固粉真也不消费预备次数，随后下一技能红伤才消费，真实10716红伤归零附加50固伤仍扣HP',()=>{for(const type of ['fixed','percent','true']){const s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true});timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:1});turn(s,20606,10127);assert.ok(sum(s,'attack',1)>0);const charge={...s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge};assert.ok(charge.token);let before,after;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){before=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,1000,'虚无已答类别接口',type);after=c.t.hp;}},()=>turn(s,20606,20309));assert.equal(before-after,1000);assert.equal(sum(s,type,1),1000);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge,charge);turn(s,20606,10716);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge,undefined);}});

success.name: 5000已答虚无不免真实梅赫维特独立属性直伤且不改已有预备，下一物理技能仍被免
success.assertion: test('5000已答虚无不免真实梅赫维特独立属性直伤且不改已有预备，下一物理技能仍被免',()=>{const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4853/snapshot.json'),s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemySoul:true,enemyLoadout:[38171,29215,29216,38172,38173]});timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:1});turn(s,20606,38171);assert.ok(sum(s,'attack',1)>0);const token=s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge.token;E.WIKI.effectsEngine.registry[2378].lyricState4853(s.fighters[1]).list=[2372,2372,2373,2374];turn(s,20606,29215);const event=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.round===2&&e.sourceSide===1&&e.redCategory==='attribute');assert.ok(event.settledDamage>0);assert.equal(event.hpLoss,event.settledDamage);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge.token,token);turn(s,20606,38171);const red=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===3&&e.sourceSide===1&&e.redCategory!=='attribute'&&e.type==='attack');assert.ok(red.length);assert.equal(red.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge,undefined);});

success.assertion: test('5000/52持续两回合逐轮判断实际先手攻击，施放时后手仍在次轮生效，后手攻击或控制未用不封对手，到期停止',()=>{for(const mode of['first','last','control']){const s=setup();turn(s,20498,37920);assert.equal(s.turns[0].first,1);if(mode==='last'){s.fighters[0].stats.spe=1;s.fighters[1].stats.spe=500;}if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=2;turn(s,10993,10127);assert.equal(red(s)===0,mode==='first');if(mode==='first'){turn(s,10993,10127);assert.ok(red(s)>0);}}});

success.assertion: test('5000/77生命用招才回100，控制不回；43轮回回满与3净弱及33清强真实状态',()=>{const s=make({move:20606,hp:1000,loadout:[20606,10993,10996,20607,31143]});turn(s,20606,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1100);s.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=2;turn(s,10993,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1100);const full=make({move:20607,hp:1000});turn(full,20607,20117);assert.equal(full.fighters[0].hp,9000);const weak=make({move:10999});weak.fighters[0].stages.def=-2;weak.fighters[0].stages.spe=1;turn(weak,10999,20117);assert.equal(weak.fighters[0].stages.def,0);assert.equal(weak.fighters[0].stages.spe,1);const clear=make({move:10998});clear.fighters[1].stages.def=2;clear.fighters[1].stages.spe=-1;turn(clear,10998,20117);assert.equal(clear.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(clear.fighters[1].stages.spe,-1);});

success.name: 5000全部26招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，真实753全部原生链含776与52先手属性，生命PP回复独立核对
success.assertion: test('5000全部26招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，真实753全部原生链含776与52先手属性，生命PP回复独立核对',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-5000.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);const restored=s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.lifePP[0].chosen.some(x=>x.key===key(m.id))?1:0,expected=m.id===31141?restored:m.id===20608?m.pp:m.pp-1+restored;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],expected,m.name);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));const p=make({move:m.id,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}});

success.assertion: test('5000/776已答冗余第二参数仍保留[2,2]，从次轮翻倍两回；错误版本和相邻参数不兼容',()=>{const s=make({move:24319});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(24319)].operations.find(x=>x.effectId===776).sourceArgs,[2,2]);turn(s,24319,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(24319)],source.moves.find(m=>m.id===24319).pp-1);assert.deepEqual([s.fighters[0].effects.doubleDamage.start,s.fighters[0].effects.doubleDamage.end],[2,3]);const copy=structuredClone(source),m=copy.moves.find(x=>x.id===24319);m.effectInstances[4].args=[2,3];assert.ok(E.WIKI.assess(copy,[24319,25678,31141,25679,31143]).issues.length>0);});

success.name: 5000全部26招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，真实753全部原生链含776与52先手属性，生命PP回复独立核对
success.assertion: test('5000全部26招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，真实753全部原生链含776与52先手属性，生命PP回复独立核对',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-5000.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);const restored=s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.lifePP[0].chosen.some(x=>x.key===key(m.id))?1:0,expected=m.id===31141?restored:m.id===20608?m.pp:m.pp-1+restored;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],expected,m.name);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));const p=make({move:m.id,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}});

success.assertion: test('5000/1217清强成功封下次攻击，906最大HP粉15逐次至45上限，936疲惫免疫失败才封属',()=>{const s=make({move:31140,index:0});s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;turn(s,31140,10127);assert.equal(red(s,1),0);const x=make({move:31140,index:1});for(let i=0;i<5;i++){turn(x,31140,20309);assert.equal(sum(x,'percent'),9000*Math.min(45,15+10*i)/100);}for(const immune of[false,true]){const y=make({move:25678,index:0});if(immune)y.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(y,25678,20117);assert.equal(!!y.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫'],!immune);assert.equal(!!y.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock,immune);}});

success.name: 5000/1222先手随机两个PP无放回清零，499只有后手授次回先制3，797清回合后技能禁疗仍允许血药
success.assertion: test('5000/1222先手随机两个PP无放回清零，499只有后手授次回先制3，797清回合后技能禁疗仍允许血药',()=>{for(const slow of[false,true]){const s=make({move:31142,index:0,aStats:{spe:slow?1:500},bStats:{spe:slow?500:1},enemyLoadout:[37920,20117,10127,20309,37911]});turn(s,31142,slow?37920:20117);assert.equal(Object.values(s.fighters[1].pp).filter(n=>n===0).length,slow?0:2);const x=make({move:31142,index:1,aStats:{spe:slow?1:500},bStats:{spe:slow?500:1},enemyLoadout:[37920,20117,10127,20309,37911]});turn(x,31142,slow?37920:20117);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].effects.id984?.amount,slow?3:undefined);}const h=make({move:31143,index:0,targetHp:1000});timer(h,1,'免弱',{});turn(h,31143,null);assert.ok(h.fighters[1].effects['技能禁疗']);assert.ok(h.fighters[1].hp>1000);});

success.assertion: test('5000/1240当回合未击败才授下一次技能三分之一最大HP附粉，控制未用不消费，状态技能可触发一次',()=>{const s=make({move:31143,index:1,loadout:[31143,20606,10993,10996,31142]});turn(s,31143,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.next12404885.count,1);s.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=2;turn(s,20606,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.next12404885.count,1);delete s.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫'];s.moveDefinitions[key(20606)].operations=[];turn(s,20606,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.next12404885,undefined);turn(s,20606,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);});

success.assertion: test('5000/1241固定吸取低于半体翻倍，等于半体不倍；残血或免伤回复仍按理论值且禁疗只挡回血',()=>{for(const hp of[4499,4500]){for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:31143,index:2,hp,targetHp:immune?9000:100});if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫',{});turn(s,31143,20117);const n=hp<4500?400:200;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,hp+n);assert.equal((s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.type==='fixed').reduce((a,e)=>a+e.settledDamage,0),immune?0:n);}}const x=make({move:31143,index:2,hp:1000});timer(x,0,'技能禁疗',{});turn(x,31143,20117);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].hp,1000);assert.equal(sum(x,'fixed'),400);});
